title: An Unsupervised and Supervised Machine Learning Approach to Evidence Tetranychus mexicanus Activity in Fluorescence and Thermal Response in Passion Fruit

key_findings: mite-infested plants showed a measurable thermal response
thermal direction is context-dependent and must not be hard-coded as warmer-is-riskier
thermal evidence is supportive rather than a species-specific diagnostic

notes: Different crop and Tetranychus species from Nongtori strawberry/T. urticae. Use for mechanism/source grounding only, not threshold transfer.
